Easiest way, nothing to sideload from a computer. Read this on your phone, type on the TV.
On the TV, install the free app “Downloader” (search for it in the Google Play Store or Amazon Appstore).
Open Downloader and type this address in its URL box, then press Go:
Choose Install. The first time, the TV asks to let Downloader install apps: allow it.
Open HomeFi on the TV. In Train it shows a code: scan it from your phone (Train → Connect to TV).
After this first install, the TV updates HomeFi by itself.
